label: propo_32
title: Proposition
body_md:
\label{propo_32}
Let $(t,x,m,v)\in[0,T)\times\mathcal{O}$ be fixed. Then
$
\kappa\mapsto b^{AI}(t,v;\kappa)
$
is strictly increasing. Consequently, $
\kappa \mapsto V^{AI}(t,x,m,v;\kappa)
$
is strictly increasing.

body_md: See Appendix \ref{proof_propo_32}.
